title: Clinical Triage Output Schema
description: Structured output produced by the Offline Clinical Triage Agent for every patient assessment. Enforced via constrained decoding on-device and validated by the deterministic safety net before display.

triage_level.description: Urgency classification. RED = immediate life threat; ORANGE = urgent referral; YELLOW = semi-urgent; GREEN = non-urgent, manage locally.

suspected_conditions.description: Ranked list of the most likely conditions based on symptoms and, if provided, image input.

red_flags.description: Clinical warning signs detected in the input (e.g., fever with rash, chest pain, altered consciousness). Empty array if none.

recommended_action.description: Plain-language action for the health worker (e.g., refer immediately to nearest hospital, treat locally and monitor for 48 hours).

confidence_score.description: Model's self-reported confidence in the triage decision. Values below the configured threshold trigger mandatory escalation.

referral_note.description: Auto-generated, printable referral note containing patient summary, triage level, red flags, and recommended receiving facility.

escalate_to_human.description: True if the deterministic safety net flags this case for human review (low confidence, conflicting rule, or unknown condition).

examples.recommended_action: Refer immediately to nearest hospital for dengue screening and platelet count.
examples.referral_note: 32F, 3-day fever with rash and nausea. Suspected dengue. Refer to district hospital for CBC and NS1 antigen test.
